{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: #6 x 1" Flat Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Self Drilling Screws with Self Tapping Screw Thread, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These look useful for the drilling and fastening work reflected in my recent tool and hardware purchases.
ItemID: 2; Title: M3-0.5 x 12mm (100 PCS) Socket Head Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 12.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Coarse Thread UNC, DIN 912; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent metric assortment already covers M3 screws, and I have no clear need for 100 of this length.
ItemID: 3; Title: Matework Step Drill Bit for Metal, Four Spiral Flute Cobalt Step Drill Bit (1/4"-3/4") Wear-Resistant TiAlN Coated, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Wood, Plastic (M35 9 Size); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Enlarging holes in sheet metal would complement my cobalt drill set and rivet tools, making this especially appealing.
ItemID: 4; Title: M6-1.0 x 30mm (20 Pcs) Socket Head Cap Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, DIN912; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought an M4–M6 bolt assortment, so I would check that supply before buying this specific size.
ItemID: 5; Title: #14 x 3/4" Flat Head Phillps Drive Self Tapping Screws, 304 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Wood Screws, 30 PCS; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a substantial screw assortment, and this particular diameter and length do not fill an obvious gap.
ItemID: 6; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Flat Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Phillips Drive, Cross Recessed 80° countersunk Head Screws, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3-2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The thread matches a size in my recent rivet-nut kit, and a flush head could be useful for assembly work.
ItemID: 7; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could also complement my rivet nuts, but I would choose the flat-head pack this time instead of stocking both.
ItemID: 8; Title: CZoffpro Duct Tape Heavy Duty, Ultra Strong Duct Tape with Waterproof Backing, Easy to Tear by Hand, 1.88 in x 20 Yard, Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: General repair tape would complement the double-sided and hook-and-loop tapes I already use.
ItemID: 9; Title: 3/8-16 x 3 (8 pcs) Pan Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Phillips Drive, Cross Recessed Pan Head Screws Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3P; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Although the thread matches my rivet-nut assortment, the three-inch length feels too specific to buy without a defined use.
ItemID: 10; Title: M8-1.25 x 20mm (12 pcs) Button Socket Head Cap Screws, Hexagon Head, Allen Hex Drive, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, ISO 7380; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My rivet-nut tool kit includes M8 nuts, while my recent metric bolt assortment stops at M6, so these could fill a useful gap."}
